definitions.rationale: Expands the named simplifyLoopBody proof term to the exact loop-body AST; it is a structural macro definition and adds no mathematical fact.
definitions.text:
rule simplifyLoopBody =>
    If(
      Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str("/"))),
      Assign(Name("part"), BinOp("+", Name("part"), Int(1))) .Stmts,
      If(
        Compare(Name("part"), CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
        Assign(
          Name("a"),
          BinOp(
            "+",
            BinOp(
              "*",
              Name("a"),
              Int(10)),
            BinOp(
              "-",
              Call(Name("ord"), Name("ch"), .Exprs),
              Int(48)))) .Stmts,
        If(
          Compare(Name("part"), CmpOp("==", Int(1))),
          Assign(
            Name("b"),
            BinOp(
              "+",
              BinOp(
                "*",
                Name("b"),
                Int(10)),
              BinOp(
                "-",
                Call(Name("ord"), Name("ch"), .Exprs),
                Int(48)))) .Stmts,
          If(
            Compare(Name("part"), CmpOp("==", Int(2))),
            Assign(
              Name("c"),
              BinOp(
                "+",
                BinOp(
                  "*",
                  Name("c"),
                  Int(10)),
                BinOp(
                  "-",
                  Call(Name("ord"), Name("ch"), .Exprs),
                  Int(48)))) .Stmts,
            Assign(
              Name("d"),
              BinOp(
                "+",
                BinOp(
                  "*",
                  Name("d"),
                  Int(10)),
                BinOp(
                  "-",
                  Call(Name("ord"), Name("ch"), .Exprs),
                  Int(48)))) .Stmts) .Stmts) .Stmts) .Stmts) .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Expands the named simplifyReturn proof term to the exact return AST, so this is a structural definition.
definitions.text:
rule simplifyReturn =>
    Return(
      Compare(
        BinOp(
          "%",
          BinOp("*", Name("a"), Name("c")),
          BinOp("*", Name("b"), Name("d"))),
        CmpOp("==", Int(0))))

definitions.rationale: Expands simplifyBody to the exact function-body statement sequence and therefore defines a named proof term.
definitions.text:
rule simplifyBody =>
    Assign(Name("part"), Int(0))
    Assign(Name("a"), Int(0))
    Assign(Name("b"), Int(0))
    Assign(Name("c"), Int(0))
    Assign(Name("d"), Int(0))
    Assign(Name("ch"), Str(""))
    For(
      Name("ch"),
      BinOp("+", BinOp("+", Name("x"), Str("/")), Name("n")),
      simplifyLoopBody)
    simplifyReturn
    .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Defines simplifyScope as the exact eight-binding callee scope map with its parent; it is a structural helper.
definitions.text:
rule simplifyScope(X, N, P, A, B, C, D, CH) =>
    scope(
      "x" |-> X
      "n" |-> N
      "part" |-> P
      "a" |-> A
      "b" |-> B
      "c" |-> C
      "d" |-> D
      "ch" |-> CH,
      parent(0))

definitions.rationale: Defines the validScan empty-sequence base case at phase 0 as false.
Defines the validScan empty-sequence base case at phase 1 as false.
Defines the validScan empty-sequence base case at phase 2 as false.
Defines the accepting validScan base case at phase 3 by the four positive-accumulator conditions.
definitions.text:
rule validScan(.IntSeq, 3, A, B, C, D) =>
    A >Int 0 andBool B >Int 0 andBool C >Int 0 andBool D >Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines validScan's phase-0 recurrence for a slash transition or a decimal Horner update while structurally consuming one code.
definitions.text:
rule validScan(iCons(CODE, REST), 0, A, B, C, D) =>
    (CODE ==Int 47 andBool validScan(REST, 1, A, B, C, D))
      orBool
    (isDigitC(CODE)
      andBool validScan(
        REST, 0, A *Int 10 +Int (CODE -Int 48), B, C, D))

Defines scanResult's valid terminal case as the modulo test on the four accumulated positive integers.
definitions.text:
rule scanResult(.IntSeq, 3, A, B, C, D) =>
    pyMod(A *Int C, B *Int D) ==Int 0
    requires A >Int 0 andBool B >Int 0
      andBool C >Int 0 andBool D >Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines scanResult's slash recurrence by consuming code 47 and advancing the phase.
definitions.text:
rule scanResult(iCons(47, REST), P, A, B, C, D) =>
    scanResult(REST, P +Int 1, A, B, C, D)
    requires 0 <=Int P andBool P <Int 3

proved_derived_lemmas.text:
rule [loop-digit-bridge]:
    <k>
      #loop(str(iCons(CODE, REST)), Name("ch"), LOOPBODY:Stmts)
      ~> RETSTMTS:Stmts
      ~> #endcall
      =>
      scanResult(iCons(CODE, REST), P, A, B, C, D)
    </k>
    <env> 1 => 0 </env>
    <scopes>
      (0 |-> scope(.Map, parent(-1))
       1 |-> CALLEESCOPE:Scope
       -1 |-> BUILTINSSCOPE:Scope)
      =>
      (0 |-> scope(.Map, parent(-1))
       -1 |-> BUILTINSSCOPE)
    </scopes>
    <scopeLoc> 2 => 1 </scopeLoc>
    <heap> .Map </heap>
    <heapLoc> 0 </heapLoc>
    <stack> ListItem(frame(.K, 0, 1)) => .List </stack>
    <ret> noRet </ret>
    <exc> NoExc </exc>
    requires LOOPBODY ==K simplifyLoopBody
     andBool RETSTMTS ==K (simplifyReturn .Stmts)
     andBool CALLEESCOPE
       ==K simplifyScope(XARG, NARG, P, A, B, C, D, OLDCH)
     andBool BUILTINSSCOPE ==K builtinsScope
     andBool 0 <=Int P andBool P <=Int 3
     andBool isDigitC(CODE)
     andBool validScan(iCons(CODE, REST), P, A, B, C, D)
    [priority(40)]
